title: Why You Feel Guilty and How to Stop It Immediately (1981-09-30)
description:
Do you constantly feel guilty or unworthy? Discover why this "curse of modern times" blocks your energy and the spiritual technique to clear it.

Shri Mataji dissects the spiritual roots of guilt and its connection to the Left Vishuddhi chakra. She explains how to witness life as a drama, exposes the dangers of false gurus like TM and Moon, and makes a major declaration about Her identity. Includes Q&A and a guided self-realization session.

Key Topics:
• 🌙 Understanding Left Vishuddhi - why guilt is an escape for the ego and how to overcome it
• 🎭 The concept of 'Leela' - learning to witness your life's problems like a drama without getting involved
• ⚡ Why mechanical chanting and 'seed mantras' can damage your throat chakra before Self-Realization
• 💬 Powerful Q&A exposing false gurus, black magic, and the dangers of the 'supra-conscious' state
• ✨ Guided self-realization experience - feel the cool breeze of the Holy Ghost on your own palms

“Left Vishuddhi is a curse of modern times. And I would request you all to come out of it. Every morning you tell yourself that 'I am not guilty!' You must say it thrice in the morning and thrice in the evening.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Audience Questions:
• How can I still my thoughts?
• What type of thinking would increase the superego?
• How do I know if someone is a realised soul?
• Is this the beginning of the end? (Regarding biological warfare)?
• What do You mean by 'secret gurus' and psychological attacks?
• I practised TM and have a mantra - what should I do with it?
• Is it all right to use seed mantras like 'lam' and 'yam'?
• What is the Kundalini and how can we raise it?
• Is Sun Myung Moon an anti-Christ?

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• How to overcome guilt and self-blame spiritually?
• What are the signs of a false spiritual teacher?
• How to protect yourself from negative psychic attacks?

Do you find yourself holding onto guilt from the past? Try the affirmation 'I am not guilty' mentioned in the talk and share how it felt.
